faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Anode Basket Hook suitable for Solid rectangular knife hook busbar for anode?
faq.a: Titanium Anode Basket Hook uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address anode system operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Anode Basket Hook?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Anode Basket Hook is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for solid rectangular knife requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Anode Basket Hook require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. solid rectangular knife components require Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for solid rectangular knife application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.
